## Owner resolution needed

The mass-coefficient lemma has an unresolved local proof step, [L1]: the full \(r^{-2}\) expansion of \(\operatorname{Ric}_{uu}\), including cancellation of the trace-free \(P_{AB}\), \(U_{(3)}\), \(V_{(1)}\), and \(\beta_{(3)}\) terms. Mädler–Winicour state the coefficient in Eq. 58, and Strominger gives a compatible constraint in Eqs. 5.2.8–5.2.9, but both summarize the final calculation ([Mädler–Winicour](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1609.01731), [Strominger](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1703.05448)). The [notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-33.notes.md) propose a helper lemma immediately before the coefficient lemma, with its exact statement and dependencies.

Readiness is hash-current: the expansion definition, BMS definition, and memory proposition are `ready`; the coefficient lemma, mass-loss proposition, and both examples are `escalated` because their mass conclusions depend on [L1].
